propositions: dc_store_copy_repo fixture fails on git fetch origin tickets with exit 128, but the failure reason from git's stderr is discarded due to subprocess.run(capture_output=True, check=True) followed by CalledProcessError string conversion
git fetch, git archive, and git ls-tree calls in the fixture use capture_output=True with check=True, which swallows stderr and prevents diagnostic error messages from being surfaced
the fetch call is an un-retried single network operation on the critical path, causing transient network failures to hard-fail the entire test harness
module-level run_git() helper must capture git's stderr verbatim and raise RuntimeError with joined command, exit status, and stderr text instead of relying on CalledProcessError
fetch_tickets() helper must implement bounded retry (FETCH_ATTEMPTS=3) with backoff on network failure, maintaining policy of retry-then-fail rather than silent skip
unit tests must verify that failure messages contain git's stderr, that transient failures are retried and recover, and that attempt counts are bounded
